# 編織日和 · 故事 story.knittinghiyori.com

> 編織日和（knittinghiyori.com）的姊妹站，專門做華語劇集、原著小說與書籍的深度分析與互動解析頁：原著與改編對照、伏筆與回收、反覆出現的意象。目前有 7 部劇集與 1 本書的互動頁，另有 4 篇放在主站的長文。

- 語言：繁體中文（早春晴朗、難哄、折月亮另有日文、英文版）
- 內容含劇情，引用時請附上原頁連結

## 工具

- [追劇日曆計算機](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/calendar/): 選一部劇或自己輸入，算出每天更新第幾集、各平台進度與大結局日，可加到行事曆；每週新增一部正在播的劇（[日本語](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/calendar/ja/)、[English](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/calendar/en/)）

## 劇集與原著小說（互動頁）

- [早春晴朗](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/the-early-spring/): 原著《姑娘別哭》，十年三幕的劇情解析、原著金句與權力翻轉（[日本語](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/the-early-spring/ja/)、[English](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/the-early-spring/en/)）
- [難哄 The First Frost](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/the-first-frost/): 原著竹已，從溫以凡的夢境出發的互動頁（[日本語](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/the-first-frost/ja/)、[English](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/the-first-frost/en/)）
- [折月亮 When I Meet the Moon](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/when-i-meet-the-moon/): 原著竹已，用月亮的盈虧重走一次故事（[日本語](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/when-i-meet-the-moon/ja/)、[English](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/when-i-meet-the-moon/en/)）
- [偷偷藏不住](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/hidden-love/): 原著竹已，十大名場面與經典台詞
- [告白](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/confession/): 原著應橙，十個瞬間的名場面整理
- [在暴雪時分](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/amidst-a-snowstorm-of-love/): 原著墨寶非寶，用九顆球拆解故事，附赫爾辛基取景地
- [點燃我，溫暖你](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/drama/lighter-and-princess/): 原著 Twentine《打火機與公主裙》，「公主」稱呼的轉變與伏筆互動解析

## 書籍

- [莫斯科紳士](https://story.knittinghiyori.com/books/a-gentleman-in-moscow/): 作者 Amor Towles，中文版或英文版的 4 題自測與閱讀進度地圖

## 放在主站的長文

- [逐玉](https://knittinghiyori.com/pursuit-of-jade/): 古裝劇名場面盤點
- [折腰](https://knittinghiyori.com/the-prisoner-of-beauty-a-lifelong-bond-of-love-and-loyalty/): 從主題曲〈故城雪〉的歌詞讀進去
- [天才女友](https://knittinghiyori.com/genius-girlfriend-2026-premiere-guide/): 追劇日曆、OST 與原著名場面對照
- [熾夏 Never Ending Summer](https://knittinghiyori.com/never-ending-summer-ending-be-or-he/): 大結局解析與追劇日曆
- [《難哄》原著與劇版差異](https://knittinghiyori.com/the-first-frost/): 溫霜降名字與伏筆解析
- [主站「劇集與小說」全部文章](https://knittinghiyori.com/category/slow-living-learning/story/): 追劇日曆與原著差異文章，[RSS](https://knittinghiyori.com/category/slow-living-learning/story/feed/)

## 相關網站

- [編織日和](https://knittinghiyori.com/): 主站部落格
- [如何追蹤編織日和](https://knittinghiyori.com/follow/): RSS 與給 AI 的追蹤指令
